challenge_ttl_seconds.description: For list: how long the issued nonces stay valid. Short by default so an unused challenge cannot be banked.

proposal_ids.description: For approve/reject. Each id must have a matching entry in `signatures` — decisions are signed one proposal at a time, because a single signature covering a batch could be reused against a different batch.

reviewed_by.description: Identifier of the person deciding. Must equal the `reviewer:` line inside every supplied signed payload; a mismatch is refused rather than silently preferring one.

signatures.description: Required for approve and reject, one entry per proposal id. Without a valid entry the call returns APPROVAL_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED and nothing changes.

key_id.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the signing public key. Must match a reviewer key in policy that is not revoked.

sig.description: Base64 of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature over signed_payload.

signed_payload.description: The exact bytes returned as `signing_payload` by the preceding list call, unmodified. Sent back verbatim rather than reconstructed — the server verifies the signature over these bytes and then checks the fields inside them against the request.
